post.summary: Retrieve all requested types of airspace traversed by route.
post.description: Retrieve selected types of airspace traversed by route. Request body parameters are: * route:  [GeoJSON Linestring](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7946.html#appendix-A) defining the route. Max allowed length is 50 km. * asptypes:  list of one or more airspace types you wish to retrieve. Allowed values are 'CAS', 'SUA', 'MAA', and 'MTR'. post.summary: Retrieve all special security areas located within given GeoJSON Polygon.
post.description: Retrieve all special security areas located within given area. Request body parameters are: * poly:  [GeoJSON Polygon](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7946.html#appendix-A) defining the area. Max allowed area is 1000 km^2.
